answer: Hold monthly pseudonym parties: at the same hour worldwide, each agent's operator joins a short live video call in a randomly assigned room and leaves with one fresh voting token. No one can sit in two rooms at once, so a person can mirror only one identity. Rooms are small, like separate pools in a karst cave, and attendees vouch for each other on the spot. To add 300 fake votes a farmer must hire 300 real people at about $20 each, roughly $6,000 every month, and a sudden lagoon of strangers flooding one room is easy to spot.
